name: Thank you product recommendations for WooCommerce
author: Sajidul Islam

sections.description:
Thank you product recommendations for WooCommerce helps you keep your customers engaged even after they complete a purchase.

Automatically show relevant products based on the items in their order on:
– The Thank You page
– The View Order page in My Account

Easily configurable from the WordPress admin:
– Show as grid or slider
– Customize the settings for the slider and gridstyles
– Select the number of products to display
– Ability to display only for specific user’s
– Display the product if purchased between dates
– Ability to display specific product types. Simple/Variable/Grouped/External

🎯 Great for increasing repeat orders and showcasing your product range.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/thank-you-product-recommendations-for-woocommerce directory, or install it via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Thank You Products to configure the settings.
  4. If there are not enough item to display on slider view, slider control elements will not be displayed.
sections.faq:
Can I choose which related products to show?

The plugin uses WooCommerce’s default related product logic, based on categories/tags.

Will it work with any theme?

Yes, it uses standard WooCommerce product templates and styling. You can override the templates if needed.

Can I disable it on the Thank You page but show on View Order?

Yes, both display locations are independently toggleable from the settings.
